summary: An inline alert / notice banner: a static, in-flow message box that announces a form-level error, a success confirmation, a warning, or an informational note, and can optionally be dismissed.

props.name: type
props.desc: `"info"` (default) | `"success"` | `"warning"` | `"error"` (`"danger"` is an alias for `"error"`). Unknown values fall back to `"info"`.

props.name: title
props.desc: Optional bold heading: a string (auto-escaped) OR a DOM node / nested `html` template / array to embed a custom element (you build it, you own its safety; plain strings stay escaped). Default `""`.

props.name: message
props.desc: Body: a string (auto-escaped) OR a DOM node / nested `html` template / array to embed a custom element (you build it, you own its safety; plain strings stay escaped). Default `""`.

props.name: closable
props.desc: Render a close button that dismisses the banner. Default `false`.

props.name: showIcon
props.desc: Show the per-type leading glyph. Default `true`.

props.name: labels
props.desc: Override UI strings. Keys: `close` (the close button's aria-label). Unset keys keep the English default.

events.name: close
events.desc: Bubbling, cancelable `CustomEvent` fired when the close button is pressed. Call `event.preventDefault()` to keep the element mounted; otherwise it removes itself.

cssProps.name: --pd-alert-bg
cssProps.desc: Soft tinted background (defaults per type to `--info-bg`/`--success-bg`/`--warning-bg`/`--danger-bg`).

cssProps.name: --pd-alert-accent
cssProps.desc: Hue for the icon + border (defaults per type to `--accent`/`--green`/`--amber`/`--red`).

summary: A compact identity avatar.

props.name: src
props.desc: Image URL. When set (and it loads) an `` is shown. Default `""`.

props.name: name
props.desc: Full name → `alt` text and the initials fallback. Author content. Default `""`.

props.name: size
props.desc: `"sm"` | `"md"` | `"lg"`, or a number of pixels (e.g. `"48"`). Default `"md"`.

props.name: shape
props.desc: `"circle"` (default) | `"square"` (rounded corners instead of a full circle).

props.name: color
props.desc: Optional explicit background colour for the initials; if unset, derived from `name`. Default `""`.

props.name: decorative
props.desc: Mark purely decorative (e.g. beside a visible name): renders `aria-hidden`, no `role`/label. Default `false`.

props.name: labels
props.desc: Override UI strings. Keys: `placeholder`. Unset keys keep the English default.

cssProps.name: --pd-avatar-size
cssProps.desc: Diameter/side of the avatar (defaults to the `md` size; a numeric `size` sets this).

summary: A small count / status overlay pinned to the top-right corner of a badged element (an icon, avatar or button).

props.name: count
props.desc: The number to display. `>max` renders `"{max}+"`. Default `0`.

props.name: max
props.desc: Cap after which `"{max}+"` is shown. Default `99`.

props.name: dot
props.desc: Show a small dot with NO number (a status marker). Default `false`.

props.name: showZero
props.desc: Show the badge when `count === 0` (otherwise hidden unless `dot`). Default `false`.

props.name: color
props.desc: Variant: `"red"` (default) | `"accent"` | `"success"` | `"warning"` | `"neutral"`.

props.name: standalone
props.desc: Render just the indicator with NO wrapped child (e.g. inline status). Default `false`.

props.name: labels
props.desc: Override UI strings. Keys: `count(n)`, `dot`. Unset keys keep the English default.

cssProps.name: --pd-badge-size
cssProps.desc: Diameter of the numeric badge (defaults to a small pill height).

cssProps.name: --pd-badge-dot
cssProps.desc: Diameter of the dot (defaults to a fraction of the badge size).

cssProps.name: --pd-badge-ring
cssProps.desc: Ring colour around the badge (defaults to `--panel`).

summary: A navigation breadcrumb trail: an ordered list of crumbs leading to the current page.

props.name: items
props.desc: The crumbs, root → current. Each `{ label, href? }`: `label` accepts a string (auto-escaped) OR a DOM node / nested `html` template / array — pass a node or template to embed a custom element (you build it, you own its safety; plain strings stay escaped); `href` (when present, and not the last crumb) makes that crumb a link. Default `[]`.

props.name: maxItems
props.desc: When set and there are more crumbs than this, the middle is collapsed to a non-interactive ellipsis crumb, keeping the first crumb and the last two. `0`/unset = show all. Default `0`.

props.name: labels
props.desc: Override UI strings. Keys: `ariaLabel` (the `<nav>` label, default `"Breadcrumb"`), `ellipsis` (collapsed indicator, default `"…"`). Unset keys keep the English default. Crumb text is CONTENT, not a label.

summary: A themed button — or link — that wraps its author-provided label content in a real native `<button>` (or an `<a href>` when `href` is set), so native focus, keyboard, `<form>` submission (`type="submit"`) and link navigation all work with no custom event wiring.

props.name: variant
props.desc: `"primary"` | `"default"` (secondary) | `"dashed"` | `"text"` | `"link"`. Default `"default"`.

props.name: size
props.desc: `"sm"` | `"md"` | `"lg"`. Default `"md"`.

props.name: type
props.desc: `"submit"` | `"button"` | `"reset"`, applied to the inner `<button>` so a submit button submits its `<form>` natively. Default `"button"`. Ignored when `href` is set.

props.name: href
props.desc: When set, render an `<a href>` instead of a `<button>`.

props.name: icon
props.desc: Optional leading inline SVG markup string (author-TRUSTED, like `menu.js` icons).

props.name: status
props.desc: Intent colour that recolours the button across every variant: `"success"` (green) | `"warning"` (amber) | `"danger"` (red). Unset by default. `danger` is the legacy shorthand for `status="danger"`.

props.name: shape
props.desc: `"default"` | `"round"` (pill) | `"circle"` (1:1, for an icon-only button). Default `"default"`.

props.name: danger
props.desc: Destructive (red) styling — shorthand for `status="danger"`. Default `false`.

props.name: disabled
props.desc: Disable the control (blocks interaction; `aria-disabled` on links). Default `false`.

props.name: loading
props.desc: Show a leading spinner glyph, set `aria-busy`, and block interaction. Default `false`.

props.name: block
props.desc: Full-width (fills the host). Default `false`.

props.name: iconRight
props.desc: Place the `icon` AFTER the label instead of before. Default `false`.

props.name: labels
props.desc: Override UI strings. Keys: `loading`. Unset keys keep the English default.

events.name: click
events.desc: Native, bubbling `click` from the inner `<button>`/`<a>` (suppressed while disabled/loading).

summary: A content CONTAINER that wraps its light-DOM children into a bordered panel with an optional header (title + an "extra" actions region) and an optional footer.

props.name: title
props.desc: Header title text (get/set). Setting it after connect updates the rendered title, creating the header if needed. Default `""`.

props.name: bordered
props.desc: Draw the panel border/background. Default `true`.

props.name: labels
props.desc: Override UI strings. Keys: `region`. Unset keys keep the English default.

summary: A form-associated boolean checkbox.

props.name: checked
props.desc: Whether the box is checked (get/set). Default `false`.

props.name: indeterminate
props.desc: Tri-state visual; sets the inner input's `.indeterminate` property (no HTML attribute). Default `false`.

props.name: disabled
props.desc: Disable the control. Default `false`.

props.name: required
props.desc: Must be checked to be valid (unchecked → `valueMissing`). Default `false`.

props.name: value
props.desc: Value submitted when checked. Default `"on"`.

props.name: label
props.desc: Content shown beside the box: a string (auto-escaped) OR a DOM node / nested `html` template / array — pass a node or template to embed a custom element (you build it, you own its safety; plain strings stay escaped). Default `""`.

props.name: error
props.desc: Inline error message; shown below and set as a custom validity. Default `""`.

props.name: labels
props.desc: Override UI strings. Keys: `required`. Unset keys keep the English default.

events.name: input
events.desc: Native, bubbling `input` from the inner checkbox. Read `.checked` / `event.target.checked`.

summary: A flex child sized by a 24-based `span`, for use inside `<puredashboard-row>`.

props.name: span
props.desc: Reflects the `span` attribute.

props.name: offset
props.desc: Reflects the `offset` attribute.

props.desc: Reserved for parity; the col carries no UI strings by default.

cssProps.desc: The base span (1..24), consumed by a `width: calc(...)` in grid.css.

cssProps.name: --pd-col-xs

cssProps.name: --pd-col-sm

cssProps.name: --pd-col-md
cssProps.desc: Span from 768px (set inline when the `md` attribute is present).

cssProps.name: --pd-col-lg
cssProps.desc: Span from 992px (set inline when the `lg` attribute is present).

cssProps.name: --pd-col-xl
cssProps.desc: Span from 1200px (set inline when the `xl` attribute is present).

summary: An accordion / disclosure group following the WAI-ARIA APG "Accordion" pattern.

props.name: items
props.desc: Item defs: `{ key: string, header: string|Node, content: string|Node, disabled?: boolean }`. `header`/`content` each accept a string (auto-escaped) OR a DOM node / nested `html` template / array — pass a node or template to embed a custom element (you build it, you own its safety; plain strings stay escaped).

props.name: multiple
props.desc: When `false` (default) the group is an ACCORDION: at most one item open, opening one closes the rest. When `true`, items open/close independently.

props.name: value
props.desc: Open state. In accordion mode a single open key (or `undefined`); in `multiple` mode an array of open keys. Get/set.

props.name: labels
props.desc: Override UI strings. Keys: `group` (the group `aria-label`). Unset keys keep the English default.

events.name: change
events.desc: Bubbling `CustomEvent`; `detail`: `{ value }` — the open key (accordion mode) or array of open keys (`multiple` mode). Fired when an item toggles.

summary: A form-associated colour picker.

props.name: value
props.desc: Current colour as a `#rrggbb` hex string (get/set). Default `"#000000"`.

props.name: disabled
props.desc: Disable the control. Default `false`.

props.name: showValue
props.desc: Show the hex code next to the swatch (read-only, mono). Default `false`.

props.name: size
props.desc: `"sm"` | `"md"` | `"lg"`. Default `"md"`.

props.name: labels
props.desc: Override UI strings. Keys: `choose`. Unset keys keep the English default.

events.desc: Native, bubbling `input` from the inner field (live drag). Read `.value` / `event.target.value`.

events.name: change
events.desc: Native, bubbling `change` from the inner field (commit). Read `.value` / `event.target.value`.

props.desc: The choices. A plain `string[]` is accepted too (then `value === label`). Default `[]`.

props.name: value
props.desc: Current selected value (get/set); the underlying option `value` (or the custom string when `allowCustom`). Default `""`.

props.name: placeholder
props.desc: Placeholder text for the empty input. Default `""`.

props.name: disabled
props.desc: Disable the control. Default `false`.

props.name: required

props.name: allowCustom
props.desc: If `true`, a typed value with no matching option is accepted as the value (free text). Default `false`.

props.name: error
props.desc: Inline error message; shown below and set as a custom validity. Default `""`.

props.name: labels
props.desc: Override UI strings. Keys: `noResults`, `required`. Unset keys keep the English default.

summary: A collapsible, syntax-highlighted JSON tree viewer.

props.name: data
props.desc: The value to render: any JS value, or a JSON string (parsed; invalid JSON falls back to raw text).

props.name: theme
props.desc: Colour mode. `"auto"` (default) follows the OS (`prefers-color-scheme`) and updates live, resolving to `light`/`dark`. ANY other value pins that mode name directly and is reflected to the `data-mode` attribute. Ten built-in palettes ship (see `PuredashboardJsonView.BUILT_IN_THEMES`): `light`, `dark`, `github-light`, `github-dark`, `monokai`, `dracula`, `solarized-light`, `solarized-dark`, `nord`, `one-dark`. A name outside that list is a valid custom mode — supply its colours via `themes[name]` (or a `[data-mode="name"]` CSS block).

props.name: themes
props.desc: Palette overrides keyed by mode name, e.g. `{ dark: {…}, "github-dark": {…}, myMode: {…} }`. Each map may set any of `bg`, `border`, `text`, `muted`, `key`, `string`, `number`, `boolean`, `null`, `punct`, `summary`, `accent` (any CSS colour); applied as `--pd-json-view-*` inline custom properties for the active mode only (they win over the built-in palette). Unset knobs keep the stylesheet default.

props.name: copyable
props.desc: Show a copy button after each leaf value. Default `true`.

props.name: level
props.desc: Initial expand depth. Omit (default) to expand everything. Otherwise a node at depth < `level` starts open and deeper nodes start collapsed (depth 0 = root): `0` collapses all (including the root), `1` shows the root's fields, `2` expands one level further, and so on. Only the INITIAL state — the user can still toggle any node; it re-applies when `data` or `level` changes.

props.name: labels
props.desc: Override UI strings. Keys: `copy`, `copied`, `items(n)`, `keys(n)`. Unset keys keep the English default.

summary: Vertical sidebar navigation.

props.name: items
props.desc: Tree of nodes. A node is `{ label, href?, icon?, badge?, children? }`: `label` (string|Node, required) is the visible text — it accepts a string OR a DOM node / nested `html` template. A leaf label renders freely, but a GROUP node's label also feeds the toggle button's `aria-label` (via the `expand`/`collapse` strings), where a node would stringify to `[object Object]`; to be safe, keep `label` a plain string when the accessible name matters. `href` (string) makes a leaf link; `icon` (string of trusted SVG markup) renders before the label; `badge` (string|Node) shows a small count/status chip — it accepts a string (auto-escaped) OR a DOM node / nested `html` template / array, so pass a node or template to embed a custom element (you build it, you own its safety; plain strings stay escaped); `children` (node[]) makes it a collapsible group.

props.name: current
props.desc: The `href` (or id) of the active item; the matching leaf gets `aria-current="page"`. Default `""`.

props.name: labels
props.desc: Override UI strings (English defaults). Keys: `ariaLabel`, `expand(group)`, `collapse(group)`.

events.name: toggle
events.desc: When a group is expanded/collapsed. `detail`: `{ label, expanded }`.

props.name: mode
props.desc: Which side content sits on: `"left"` (default), `"right"`, or `"alternate"` (zig-zag). Default `"left"`.

props.name: reverse
props.desc: Render the items in reverse order (newest first). Default `false`.

props.name: pending
props.desc: Append a trailing ghost item with an animated spinner dot. A string is its content; `true` uses the `pending` label. Falsy → no pending item. Default `false`.

props.name: labels
props.desc: Override UI strings. Keys: `pending`. Unset keys keep the English default.

summary: A custom, draggable window titlebar for FRAMELESS desktop apps (Tauri / Wails / Electron `frame:false`).

props.name: platform
props.desc: `"auto"` (default) | `"mac"` | `"windows"` | `"linux"`. `"auto"` detects via `navigator.userAgentData?.platform`, else `navigator.platform`.

props.name: title
props.desc: Text rendered as the titlebar's title label (centered on mac, left on windows/linux). Default `""`.

props.name: controls
props.desc: Force-render the custom minimize/maximize/close buttons regardless of platform (mac hides them by default). Default `false`.

props.name: maximized
props.desc: Reflected. When `true`, the maximize button shows a RESTORE glyph + label. Set this from the host to mirror the real window state. Default `false`.

props.name: labels
props.desc: Override the button aria-labels. Keys: `minimize`, `maximize`, `restore`, `close`. Unset keys keep the English default.

events.name: minimize
events.desc: `CustomEvent` (bubbles, composed) — the host should minimize the window.

events.name: maximizetoggle
events.desc: `CustomEvent` (bubbles, composed) — the host should toggle maximize/restore, then reflect the result via the `maximized` attribute.

events.name: close
events.desc: `CustomEvent` (bubbles, composed) — the host should close the window.

cssProps.name: --pd-titlebar-mac-inset
cssProps.desc: Left inset reserved for the macOS traffic lights (default `78px`).

summary: An accessible hover/focus tooltip that wraps a single trigger element (the author's child — a `<button>`, icon, link, …).

props.name: text
props.desc: The tooltip label (required content). Rendered via `textContent`. Default `""`.

props.name: placement
props.desc: `"top"` | `"bottom"` | `"left"` | `"right"`. Default `"top"`. Flips on viewport overflow.

props.name: delay
props.desc: Milliseconds before showing on hover/focus. Default `100`.

props.name: disabled
props.desc: When `true`, the tooltip never shows. Default `false`.

props.name: labels
props.desc: Override UI strings. Keys: `tooltip`. Unset keys keep the English default.

cssProps.name: --pd-tooltip-offset
cssProps.desc: Gap between trigger and tooltip (defaults to `--sp-2`).

summary: Single-select hierarchical tree view.

props.name: nodes
props.desc: Hierarchical data. A node is `{ id, label, icon?, children? }`: `id` (string, required) is its stable key; `label` (string|Node, required) is the visible text — it accepts a string (auto-escaped) OR a DOM node / nested `html` template / array, so pass a node or template to embed a custom element (you build it, you own its safety; plain strings stay escaped); `icon` (string of trusted SVG markup) renders before the label; `children` (node[]) makes it an expandable parent. Default `[]`.

props.name: selectedKey
props.desc: `id` of the selected node (get/set). Default `""` (none).

props.name: expandedKeys
props.desc: `id`s of expanded parents; accepts an array or a `Set` (normalised to a `Set` internally). Default `[]`.

props.name: labels
props.desc: Override UI strings (English defaults). Keys: `ariaLabel`.

events.name: select
events.desc: Bubbling `CustomEvent` on selection. `detail`: `{ key, node }`.

events.name: toggle
events.desc: Bubbling `CustomEvent` on expand/collapse. `detail`: `{ key, expanded }`.

summary: Drag-and-drop file picker with image thumbnails, per-file upload progress, and native multipart form submission.

props.name: files
props.desc: (read-only getter) the currently-selected File objects.

props.name: accept
props.desc: Accept filter, e.g. `"image/*,.pdf"` (same syntax as `<input accept>`). Default `""` = any. NOTE: a UX hint only — client-side type/size checks are trivially bypassable (rename, spoofed MIME, direct `uploadFile()`), so the SERVER must validate content, size and storage.

props.name: multiple
props.desc: Allow more than one file. Default `false`.

props.name: maxSize
props.desc: Max bytes per file; `0` = unlimited. Default `0`. UX hint only — enforce real limits server-side (see `accept`).

props.name: debug
props.desc: `console.debug` every emitted event. Default `false`.

props.name: labels
props.desc: Override UI strings (English defaults). Keys: `browse`, `hint`, `choose`, `tooLarge(maxStr)`, `notAllowed`, `remove(name)`. Function-valued keys interpolate. Unset keys keep the English default.

props.name: uploader
props.desc: Custom transport `(file, onProgress:(0..1)=>void) => Promise<{response}>` used by `upload()` instead of the built-in multipart XHR.

events.name: files
events.desc: Selection changed. `detail`: `File[]`.

events.name: uploadstart
events.desc: `upload()` began. `detail`: `{ count: number }`.

events.name: uploadprogress
events.desc: One file advanced. `detail`: `{ file: File, progress: number }` (0..1).

events.name: uploaddone
events.desc: One file succeeded. `detail`: `{ file: File, response }`.

events.name: uploaderror
events.desc: One file failed. `detail`: `{ file: File, error: string }`.

events.name: uploadcomplete
events.desc: All files finished. `detail`: `{ results: Array<{file,ok,response?,error?}> }`.
